name: Alexander Geddes
description: University of Otago remote-sensing co-author, Tasman Glacier, 2014.
story: GeoCart 2014 accepted abstracts, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Alexander Geddes as an author of “A multi-epoch triangulation of stereo ASTER images for Tasman Glacier elevation change”.

The original GeoCart 2014 accepted abstract identifies Geddes, Pascal Sirguey and Nicolas Cullen with the University of Otago. The study used multiple stereo ASTER satellite-image epochs to reconstruct elevation changes at Tasman Glacier. It provides a dated New Zealand example of photogrammetry and remote sensing for measuring glacier surface changes, without distinguishing the individual technical steps performed by each co-author.
